title: 第2431章 这就是四像第2430章 稍作等待
content_zh:
“萧小姐，萧老爷子没有在府邸内吗？”李落装作很随意的问道。
按理来说，远来的客人，特别是像李落这种大宗门的长老，绝对算得上是贵客了，应该由一家之主来接待才对。
奈何萧家的地位实在是太高，所以李落并没有得到应有的礼遇。
萧菲姚脸上浮现出些许愧色，解释道：“爹爹他近几年特别忙，很少会离开自己的书房，不光是李前辈您了，去年叠竹书院的院长来访，我爹爹都没有亲自接待，所以还望李前辈能够理解。”
要说不在意，那是不可能的。
但是李落也知道自己“人微言轻”，特别是与叠竹书院这种谪仙阁的嫡系宗门比的话，豢兽宗在萧家这里的地位相对还是有差距的，又何况别人来的是院长呢。
所以嘛，李落也只能装作不在意的笑了笑：“萧老爷子日理万机，老朽自然理解。”
至于萧青墨到底在忙什么，也无需多问，上一任风在渊死后，位置一直空着，但凡有机会接替这个位置的人，想来都不会浪费时间，修行也好、打点关系也罢，终归会倾尽全力，更何况萧青墨是风在渊最有力的接班人。
“对了，萧老爷子这几年特别忙，那么接待之事，多半是由萧小姐的哥哥萧易行萧公子来主持咯？”李落问道。
萧菲姚闻言双眸中再次闪过厌恶之色。
并摇头道：“哥哥也有自己的事情要忙，府内大小事宜，现在几乎都由我的妹妹萧甄来主持。”
“哦？”李落面上浮现出诧异之色，“萧甄萧大小姐，老朽没有记错的话，好像才一千岁出头，并且实力还没有到达九重天？”
萧菲姚眸子深处飘过一抹不甘，但很快就将其隐去。
“妹妹虽然修为差了些，但是人很聪慧，倒也能暂时接替爹爹肩上的担子。”
李落仿佛没有察觉到萧菲姚刚才那一瞬间的情绪一般。
轻叹道：“哎，我还以为即便不是萧公子来接替萧老爷子的担子，也会由萧小姐您来担此大任呢，看来啊...”
话没说安。
李落便乖乖闭上了嘴巴。
因为他已经察觉到了萧菲姚那冰冷的目光正盯着自己。
“对了萧小姐，萧老爷子对风在渊这个位置有多大的把握？”李落转移话题道。

萧菲姚摇了摇头：“这我就不清楚了，平时我很少同爹爹沟通。”
李落撇了撇嘴，心说你这是不跟萧青墨沟通？你这分明是不想与我沟通。
两人有一出没一出的聊了大概半个时辰后。
面前那栋七层的高楼，从六楼起自上而下开始有灯光出现并从窗户投射出来。
不多会。
几个面容姣好，气质各异的女子纷纷出现在一楼大门处。
她们看上去很是疲惫，但脸上却充满了笑容，每一个人的手里，都攥着个钱袋子，走起路来时叮铃叮铃作响。
见那几个女子莺莺燕燕从大门处走出后。
李落惊讶的侧过头去，微微张着嘴巴，一副震惊得难以言说的表情。
萧菲姚面上浮现出些许红晕，侧过头去装作没看见李落那副欲言又止的模样。
不多会儿。
几个女人从凉亭边路过，异口同声喊了声“萧小姐好”。
萧菲姚摆了摆手，面露嫌弃道：“拿着钱赶紧走！”
面对萧菲姚那厌恶的态度，几个女人并不生气，笑吟吟的离开了院落。
几人刚一消失。
有个中气略显不足的声音忽地响起。
“妹妹，这大晚上的，你怎么会想着来看哥哥呢？”
听闻此言。
李落抬头望去，就见七楼的栏杆处，有个长得颇为俊俏的高大男子，正弓着身子趴在栏杆上。
content_en:
"Miss Xiao, isn't Mr. Xiao in the mansion?" Li Luo asked pretending to be casual.
Logically speaking, guests from far away, especially elders from large sects like Li Luo, are definitely considered distinguished guests and should be received by the head of the family.
However, the status of the Xiao family was too high, so Li Luo did not receive the courtesy he deserved.
Xiao Feiyao showed a little shame on her face and explained: "Dad has been very busy in recent years and rarely leaves his study. It's not just you, Senior Li. Last year, the dean of Diezhu Academy came to visit, but my father didn't even receive him personally, so I hope Senior Li can understand."
To say that you don't care is impossible.
But Li Luo also knew that he was "a person who speaks lightly", especially compared with the direct sects of the Banished Immortal Pavilion such as Diezhu Academy, the status of the Bodhisattva Sect in the Xiao family was still relatively low, not to mention that someone else was the dean.
Therefore, Li Luo could only pretend not to care and smiled: "Mr. Xiao has many things to do, so I understand."
As for what Xiao Qingmo is busy with, there is no need to ask. After the death of the previous Feng Zaiyuan, the position has been vacant. Anyone who has the opportunity to take over this position will not waste time, whether it is cultivation or building relationships, he will eventually give his best. What's more, Xiao Qingmo is Feng Zaiyuan's most powerful successor.
"By the way, Mr. Xiao has been very busy in the past few years, so the reception will probably be hosted by Miss Xiao's brother Xiao Yixing, Mr. Xiao?" Li Luo asked.
Hearing this, Xiao Fei and Yao's eyes flashed with disgust again.
He shook his head and said: "Brother also has his own things to be busy with. Almost all matters in the house, big and small, are now handled by my sister Xiao Zhen."
"Oh?" A look of surprise appeared on Li Luo's face, "Miss Xiao Zhenxiao, if I remember correctly, she is only a thousand years old, and her strength has not reached the ninth level yet?"
There was a hint of unwillingness in the depths of Xiao Feiyao's eyes, but she quickly concealed it.
"Although my sister is a little inferior in cultivation, she is very smart and can temporarily take over the burden on my father's shoulders."
Li Luo seemed not to notice Xiao Feiyao's emotions at that moment.
Sighing softly: "Hey, I thought that even if Mr. Xiao was not here to take over Mr. Xiao's responsibilities, Miss Xiao would still be the one to take on this important responsibility. It seems..."
Nothing was said.
Li Luo obediently shut his mouth.
Because he had noticed Xiao Feiyao's cold eyes staring at him.
"By the way, Miss Xiao, how confident is Mr. Xiao about Feng Zaiyuan's position?" Li Luo changed the subject.
Xiao Feiyao shook her head: "I don't know about that. I rarely communicate with my father."
Li Luo curled his lips and thought to himself, are you not communicating with Xiao Qingmo? You clearly don't want to communicate with me.
The two chatted in and out for about half an hour.
In the seven-story building in front of us, starting from the sixth floor, lights began to appear from top to bottom and projected from the windows.
Not much.
Several beautiful-looking women with different temperaments appeared at the gate on the first floor.
They looked very tired, but their faces were full of smiles. Each of them held a money bag in their hands, and the bells jingled as they walked.
After seeing those women Yingying Yanyan walking out of the gate.
Li Luo turned his head sideways in surprise, his mouth slightly open, with an expression of shock that was beyond words.
A slight blush appeared on Xiao Feiyao's face, and she turned her head to the side and pretended not to see Li Luo's hesitant look.
Not long.
Several women passed by the pavilion and shouted "Hello, Miss Xiao" in unison.
Xiao Fei and Yao waved their hands, showing disgust and said: "Take the money and leave quickly!"
Facing Xiao Feiyao's disgusting attitude, the women were not angry and left the courtyard with smiles.
Several people just disappeared.
A slightly out of breath voice suddenly sounded.
"Sister, this late at nightYeah, why are you thinking of coming to see your brother? "
Hear this.
Li Luo looked up and saw a tall, handsome man hunched over the railing on the seventh floor.
